  back to the available width. The advertised "~80 characters per line"

- The Fixed width slider ranged over the screen width, leaving the upper
  part of its travel unreachable.
- matchesPreset() also branched on screen width, so resizing the window

ContentView now measures its own width and passes it to AaPanel, which
bases these decisions on that instead. Preset detection accepts either
width form so it no longer depends on the current size at all.

iPadOS 26 replaced Split View and Slide Over with freely resizable
windows, which makes window width differing from screen width the normal
case rather than an edge case.

TypewriterController takes the guide hairline scale from the view's own
traitCollection.displayScale, removing the last UIScreen.main use.
